blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An umbrella group of cement manufacturers in the Philippines expects cement demand to finish the year flat, as construction activity across public and private projects remains sluggish. Reinier Dizon, president of the Cement Manufacturers Association of the Philippines (Cemap), said cement demand from January to September was down 2 to 3 percent from the same period last year. READ: Why Government Infrastructure Spending Matters for Jobs and Business But the group is banking on a pickup in construction activity in the fourth quarter to help demand recover and at least match last year’s estimated 34 million metric tons (MT), […]...
